system.description:
Trained by no single circle: an itinerant tradition passed between solitary druids, hermits and wandering teachers, beholden to no Hierophant.

  • Wayfarer's Form: the first time you Wild Shape each day, you gain temporary HP equal to your Druid level.
    • 9th level, Wild Instinct: you can shift as part of your movement.
  • Horizon Reader: Advantage on Nature Lore checks in any region after a full day in it, without designating it as a trained region.
